summary:
Dynamic Full Stack Developer with 2+ years of hands-on experience in PHP frameworks like Laravel and CodeIgniter.
Enhanced application performance through optimized SQL queries, while demonstrating strong problem-solving skills.
Adept at API integrations and managing WordPress sites, delivering impactful solutions that improve user experi-
ence and operational efficiency. Eager to contribute enthusiasm, adaptability, and a fresh perspective to a dynamic
team.

skills._method: flashtext_skills_section | fuzzy(HTML→HTML5(100%), CodeIgniter.→CodeIgniter(96%), problem-solving→Problem Solving(100%), adaptability→Adaptability(100%))

pre_date_header: TUMBLEDRY, Noida, UP: Full-Stack Developer (Product Development)
bullets: Maintained and enhanced in-house CodeIgniter apps; delivered 8 feature releases and resolved production bugs , code improvements to improve system stability.
Owned the Lead CRM (CodeIgniter) used by 80+ sales agents — implemented enhancements , API integrations and supported day-to-day operations that increased lead processing throughput by 35%.
Integrated Shopify Admin GraphQL into Laravel backend and deployed cron syncs (runs 4×/hour) — eliminated 80% of manual reconciliation and improved data freshness.
Optimized MySQL queries and indexing in the Factory Module — refactored slow queries and added pagination, reducing average page load from 6.0s → 1.8s (approx. 70% faster).
Managed WordPress (Elementor) site: built 10+ pages via PHP templates and partnered with SEO to raise organic sessions by 25% over 3 months.
Built and supported a Ticket Management System (CodeIgniter) — centralized issue tracking and cut average ticket resolution time from 48h → 18h.
Introduced Git-based workflows and created technical documentation for handovers and new hires.
Core tech: PHP, CodeIgniter, Laravel, MySQL (query optimization), Shopify Admin GraphQL, WordPress (Ele- mentor), JavaScript/jQuery, Git, Cron jobs, REST APIs.

pre_date_header: FIRSTVITE E-LEARNING PVT. LTD., Noida, UP: Full-Stack Developer
bullets: Developed and maintained projects (GoingBo, IIMSR, CollegeVihar) serving 5,000+ monthly users; implemented secure form handling and admin panels that processed 6,000+ monthly submissions.
Integrated REST APIs (Tek Travels) and Razorpay payments — improved transaction success rate to 98% and reduced failed-payment support tickets by 40%.
Used AJAX/jQuery for dynamic UX improvements, reducing full-page reloads and improving user flow completion rates by 20%.
Built a Bulk SMS marketing system (Sirf SMS JSON API) that delivered 5,000+ messages across campaigns and supported targeted outreach.
Led code reviews and QA for the Genlead project as senior developer — improved code quality and reduced post-release defects by 40%.
Core tech: PHP, Laravel, HTML5/CSS3, JavaScript, AJAX, jQuery, Bootstrap, MySQL, REST APIs, Razorpay, Sirf

pre_date_header: DAZZLER SOFTWARE PVT. LTD., Kota, Raj.: Junior Web Developer

My responsibilities encompassed creating and maintaining web applications, ensuring they are user-friendly, re- sponsive, and feature-rich.
